questions.question: hey i need to post an announcement for my class on blackboard, how?
questions.answer: To post an announcement, go to **Details and Actions → Create Announcements**, click the **plus sign** in the top‑right, enter the title, select recipients, and write the message; optionally check “Send an email copy to recipients” or “schedule announcement” and set dates/times. Click **Save** to keep a draft, then click **Post** to make the announcement visible to students.

questions.question: how do grades get from blackboard into banner at the end of term
questions.answer: Faculty members enter grades electronically into Blackboard, which then forwards the grades to the registration system (Banner) via the Grade Transfer Dashboard after the required approvals from the Chair and Dean.

questions.question: What does the UOS Faculty Handbook cover?
questions.answer: The handbook provides faculty‑related policies, procedures and essential information to support members throughout their careers at UoS. It also describes the university’s academic, technological and personal facilities—including research labs, lecture halls, library resources, recreational and wellness amenities, dining options, and professional‑development programs.

questions.question: how can i see who showed up to my collaborate class
questions.answer: You can identify who is present by watching the purple Collaborate camera icon, which turns on for you and any course members who are active in the room; students who remain in the session are automatically marked as attending.

questions.question: I'm a new faculty member - what kinds of leave am I entitled to?
questions.answer: You are entitled to sick leave — full pay for up to 15 working days and half‑pay for a further 15 working days each contract year; if all sick‑leave days are used you may then draw on annual vacation leave, although new faculty on probation are not granted annual leave.
